<!-- Generated by `krn adopt`; rerun it to refresh this block. -->
# Delivery rules

- **R-1** When work is managed, the lead MUST keep task status in `tasks/<id>.json` with `krn task`; workers MUST NOT edit tracker files.
- **R-2** When agent state is written, the author MUST keep it under `.krn/`, which is ignored by git.
- **R-3** When a change is ready, the author MUST obtain a green `ci / Check` on the exact HEAD; the repository has no other required gate.
- **R-4** When a commit completes a managed task, its last trailer paragraph MUST carry `Ticket: <id>` (`Refs: <id>` while the task stays open).
<!-- krn-adoption:end -->

<!-- Generated by `krn adopt` from .agents/standards.json; rerun it to refresh this block. -->
# Standards

- **s-tests-tracked** The repository tracks automated tests next to the code they cover. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)(tests?|__tests__|spec)/|(_test\.go|_test\.py|(^|/)test_[^/]*\.py|\.(test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?)$' || git grep -qIE '#\[(cfg\(test\)|([a-z_]+::)*test(\(.*\))?)\]' -- '*.rs'`)_
- **s-test-command** The repository declares one test command that runs its tests, never a placeholder. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `if [ -s package.json ]; then node -e 'const t=(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("package.json","utf8")).scripts||{}).test||"";process.exit(t.trim()===""||/no test specified/.test(t)?1:0)'; elif [ -f composer.json ] || [ -f phpunit.xml ] || [ -f phpunit.xml.dist ]; then if [ -f phpunit.xml ] || [ -f phpunit.xml.dist ]; then true; else node -e 'const s=(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("composer.json","utf8")).scripts||{}).test;process.exit(s===undefined||/no test specified/.test(JSON.stringify(s))?1:0)'; fi; elif [ -f go.mod ]; then git ls-files | grep -q '_test\.go$'; elif [ -f Cargo.toml ]; then git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)tests/[^/]+\.rs$' || git grep -qIE '#\[(cfg\(test\)|([a-z_]+::)*test(\(.*\))?)\]' -- '*.rs'; elif [ -f pyproject.toml ] || [ -f setup.cfg ] || [ -f setup.py ] || [ -f tox.ini ] || [ -f pytest.ini ]; then git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)(test_[^/]*|[^/]*_test)\.py$'; else grep -qE '^test:' Makefile 2>/dev/null; fi`)_
- **s-test-exit-code** The test command exits non-zero when a test fails: no `|| true`, `; exit 0` or leading `-` masks its status. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `{ [ ! -s package.json ] || node -e 'const s=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("package.json","utf8")).scripts||{};const bad=Object.entries(s).filter(([k,v])=>/^test/.test(k)&&/\|\|\s*(true|:|exit 0)|;\s*exit 0\s*$/.test(String(v)));if(bad.length){console.error("masked: "+bad.map(b=>b[0]).join(", "));process.exit(1)}'; } && { [ ! -f Makefile ] || awk '/^test[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*:/{t=1;next} /^[^\t]/{t=0} t&&(/\|\| *(true|:)/||/^\t-/){bad=1} END{exit bad}' Makefile; }`)_
- **s-ci-runs-tests** Continuous integration runs the tests on every pull request. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `ci=$(cat .github/workflows/*.yml .github/workflows/*.yaml .gitlab-ci.yml 2>/dev/null); printf '%s\n' "$ci" | grep -qE 'pull_request|merge_request' && printf '%s\n' "$ci" | grep -qE '(pytest|tox|nox|unittest|(npm|pnpm|yarn|bun)( run)? test|vitest|jest|node --test|go test|cargo test|make test|uv run|hatch run|poetry run|phpunit|composer( run)? test)|uses: *[^ ]*/[^ ]*ci\.ya?ml'`)_
- **s-no-secrets-tracked** No tracked file is a credential file or holds a private key or provider token. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git ls-files | grep -vE '\.env\.(example|sample|template|dist)$' | grep -qE '(^|/)(\.env(\.[^/]*)?|id_rsa|id_ecdsa|id_ed25519|[^/]*\.pem|[^/]*\.p12|\.netrc|\.git-credentials)$' && ! git grep -qIE -e '-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----' -e 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}' -e 'gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}' -e 'xox[abp]-[0-9A-Za-z-]{20,}'`)_
- **s-no-dependency-dirs-tracked** Installed dependencies, caches and bytecode are never tracked. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)(node_modules|__pycache__|\.venv|venv|\.pytest_cache|\.mypy_cache|\.ruff_cache|\.tox)/|\.py[co]$'`)_
- **s-linter-configured** A formatter or linter is configured for the stack, so style is checked by a tool, not by review. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `for f in biome.json biome.jsonc .eslintrc .eslintrc.* eslint.config.* .prettierrc .prettierrc.* prettier.config.* ruff.toml .ruff.toml .flake8 .pylintrc .golangci.yml .golangci.yaml .golangci.toml rustfmt.toml .rustfmt.toml phpcs.xml phpcs.xml.dist .phpcs.xml phpstan.neon phpstan.neon.dist .php-cs-fixer.php .php-cs-fixer.dist.php pint.json psalm.xml; do [ -e "$f" ] && exit 0; done; grep -qE '^\[tool\.(ruff|black|flake8|pylint)' pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null || grep -qE '"(@biomejs/biome|eslint|prettier)"' package.json 2>/dev/null || cat .github/workflows/*.y*ml 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'gofmt|go vet|golangci|cargo fmt|cargo clippy'`)_
- **s-readme-test-command** The README states how to run the tests. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `cat README* readme* 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '(pytest|tox|nox|unittest|(npm|pnpm|yarn|bun)( run)? test|vitest|jest|node --test|go test|cargo test|make test|uv run|hatch run|poetry run|phpunit|composer( run)? test)'`)_
- **s-no-conflict-markers** No tracked file holds an unresolved merge conflict marker. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE '^(<<<<<<<|>>>>>>>) '`)_
- **s-one-instruction-file** A repository keeps one instruction file for agents, AGENTS.md; any other agent instruction file is a link to it or points to it. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `for f in CLAUDE.md GEMINI.md .cursorrules .github/copilot-instructions.md; do [ ! -e "$f" ] || [ "$(readlink "$f")" = AGENTS.md ] || grep -q 'AGENTS.md' "$f" || { echo "$f does not point to AGENTS.md" >&2; exit 1; }; done`)_
- **s-clean-checkout-tests** The test suite gives the same verdict on a clean checkout: no test depends on untracked local state such as an earlier build or the enclosing repository. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `[ ! -s package.json ] || node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),cp=require("child_process");const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json","utf8")).scripts||{};if(/\b(build|tsc|tsup|esbuild|rollup|webpack)\b/.test([s.pretest,s.test].join(" ")))process.exit(0);const files=cp.execFileSync("git",["ls-files","-z"],{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0");if(files.some(f=>/(^|\/)dist\//.test(f)))process.exit(0);const bad=files.filter(f=>/\.(test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$|(^|\/)(tests?|__tests__)\/.*\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/.test(f)&&fs.existsSync(f)&&/["\x27`][^"\x27`\s]*\bdist\/[^"\x27`\s]*\.[cm]?js["\x27`]/.test(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")));if(bad.length){console.error("tests read untracked dist/ output but the test script builds nothing: "+bad.slice(0,3).join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-regression-lowest-layer** A fixed defect gets its regression test in the same commit: each of the last ten `fix` commits touches a test file, or carries a `No-test: <reason>` line. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || git log --no-merges -n 10 --format=%H | while read -r c; do git log -1 --format=%s "$c" | grep -qE '^fix(\([^)]*\))?!?: ' || continue; git log -1 --format=%B "$c" | grep -qE '^No-test: .+' && continue; git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r --root "$c" | grep -qE '(^|/)(tests?|__tests__|spec)/|_test\.(go|py)$|(^|/)test_[^/]*\.py$|\.(test|spec)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$|Test\.php$' || exit 1; done`)_
- **s-role-names** Files, functions, tests and work are named by purpose and role, never by phase, ticket, round, date or version. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git ls-files | grep -vE '(^|/)fixtures/' | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs|py|php|sh|go)$' | grep -qiE '(^|[-_./])((phase|slice|round|ticket|sprint)[-_.]?[0-9]+|t-[a-z0-9]{7})([-_.]|$)|20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|[-_.]v[0-9]+[-_.]'`)_
- **s-exit-codes** Every error path has a stated exit code (64 usage, 65 invalid data, 70 internal, 75 temporary) and a message on stderr. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE '(catch[^{]*\{[^}]*process\.exit\([[:space:]]*0|except[^:]*:[[:space:]]*(sys\.)?exit\([[:space:]]*0)' -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.js' '*.jsx' '*.mjs' '*.cjs' '*.py'`)_
- **s-secrets-redacted** Values that may hold credentials, multiline ones included, are redacted before they are logged, persisted or forwarded. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIiE '(console\.(log|error|warn|info|debug)|logger\.[a-z]+|logging\.[a-z]+|print|echo)[[:space:]]*\(?.*(password|passwd|secret|api_?key|private_?key|auth_?token|access_?token)[A-Za-z_]*[[:space:]]*[,)+}]' -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.js' '*.jsx' '*.mjs' '*.cjs' '*.py' '*.php' '*.sh' ':(exclude)test' ':(exclude)tests' ':(exclude)__tests__' ':(exclude)*.test.*' ':(exclude)*.spec.*' ':(exclude)*/fixtures/*'`)_
- **s-no-shared-stash** Never change the git stash stack with a bare `git stash` or `git stash pop`; set work aside with a commit. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE 'git[[:space:]]+stash([[:space:]]+(push|save|pop|apply|drop|clear)([^A-Za-z]|$)|[[:space:]]*($|[;&|)"]))' -- '*.sh' '*.bash' '*.yml' '*.yaml' Makefile justfile package.json`)_
- **s-php-composer-lock** A PHP project that declares Composer packages tracks its composer.lock. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `[ ! -f composer.json ] || ! node -e 'const c=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("composer.json","utf8"));const d=Object.keys({...c.require,...c["require-dev"]}).filter(k=>!/^(php|php-.*|ext-.*|lib-.*|composer(-.*)?)$/.test(k));process.exit(d.length?0:1)' || git ls-files --error-unmatch composer.lock >/dev/null 2>&1`)_
- **s-php-composer-scripts** A PHP project with composer.json declares the composer scripts `test` and `lint`, so agents and CI run the same named checks. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `[ ! -f composer.json ] || node -e 'const s=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("composer.json","utf8")).scripts||{};const m=["test","lint"].filter(k=>!(k in s));if(m.length){console.error("composer.json lacks scripts: "+m.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-php-no-raw-request-output** PHP code never echoes request input (`$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_REQUEST`, `$_COOKIE`) without escaping it at the output boundary. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE '(echo|print)[[:space:]]+\$_(GET|POST|REQUEST|COOKIE)|<\?=[[:space:]]*\$_(GET|POST|REQUEST|COOKIE)' -- '*.php' '*.phtml'`)_
- **s-php-no-tracked-salts** No tracked PHP file defines a WordPress authentication key or salt as a literal; secrets, salts and deployment settings live in the private .env. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -hIE "define\( *['\"](AUTH|SECURE_AUTH|LOGGED_IN|NONCE)_(KEY|SALT)['\"] *, *['\"][^'\"]{16,}['\"]" -- '*.php' | grep -v 'put your unique phrase here' | grep -q .`)_
- **s-php-no-error-suppression** PHP code does not silence a function call with the `@` operator; it checks the result or catches the exception. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const sh=(a)=>cp.execFileSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);const src=sh(["ls-files","-z","--","*.php","*.phtml"]).filter(f=>!/(^|\/)(vendor|node_modules|tests?|spec)\//.test(f));const code=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>!/^\s*(\*|\/\/|#|\/\*)/.test(l)).join("\n");const bad=src.filter(f=>/(^|[^\w@"\x27$])@\s*\\?[A-Za-z_][\w\\]*\s*\(/.test(code(f)));if(bad.length){console.error("@ suppression in: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-php-no-empty-catch** A PHP `catch` block is never empty; it handles, logs or rethrows the error, or says in a comment why it is ignored. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const sh=(a)=>cp.execFileSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);const src=sh(["ls-files","-z","--","*.php","*.phtml"]).filter(f=>!/(^|\/)(vendor|node_modules|tests?|spec)\//.test(f));const code=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>!/^\s*(\*|\/\/|#|\/\*)/.test(l)).join("\n");const bad=src.filter(f=>/catch\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{\s*\}/.test(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")));if(bad.length){console.error("empty catch in: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-php-no-eval** PHP code does not call `eval()` or `create_function()`; behavior is written as code or looked up in a map. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const sh=(a)=>cp.execFileSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);const src=sh(["ls-files","-z","--","*.php","*.phtml"]).filter(f=>!/(^|\/)(vendor|node_modules|tests?|spec)\//.test(f));const code=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>!/^\s*(\*|\/\/|#|\/\*)/.test(l)).join("\n");const bad=src.filter(f=>/(^|[^\w>:$])(eval|create_function)\s*\(/.test(code(f)));if(bad.length){console.error("eval in: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-php-autoload-declared** A PHP project with Composer and classes under a src directory declares its Composer autoload, so classes load by namespace and not by hand-written require calls. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `[ ! -f composer.json ] || ! git ls-files | grep -q '^s[r]c/.*\.php$' || node -e 'const c=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("composer.json","utf8"));const a=c.autoload||{};process.exit(Object.keys(a).length?0:1)'`)_
- **s-php-composer-no-wildcard** composer.json never requires a package at `*`, `dev-*` or `@dev`; each package carries a version constraint a release can be rebuilt from. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `[ ! -f composer.json ] || node -e 'const c=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("composer.json","utf8"));const all={...c.require,...c["require-dev"]};const bad=Object.entries(all).filter(([k,v])=>!/^(php|php-.*|ext-.*|lib-.*|composer(-.*)?)$/.test(k)&&/^(\*|dev-.*|.*@dev)$/.test(String(v).trim())).map(([k])=>k);if(bad.length){console.error("unpinned: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-wp-escape-translations** WordPress templates print translated text through `esc_html_e`, `esc_attr_e` or `esc_html__`, never the bare `_e()` or `echo __()`. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const sh=(a)=>cp.execFileSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);const src=sh(["ls-files","-z","--","*.php","*.phtml"]).filter(f=>!/(^|\/)(vendor|node_modules|tests?|spec)\//.test(f));const code=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>!/^\s*(\*|\/\/|#|\/\*)/.test(l)).join("\n");const bad=src.filter(f=>/(^|[^\w>:$])_e\s*\(|\b(echo|print)\s+__\s*\(/m.test(code(f)));if(bad.length){console.error("unescaped translation in: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-wp-nonce-on-request** A WordPress PHP file that reads `$_POST` or `$_REQUEST` verifies a nonce (`wp_verify_nonce`, `check_admin_referer`, `check_ajax_referer`) or a REST `permission_callback`. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const sh=(a)=>cp.execFileSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);const src=sh(["ls-files","-z","--","*.php","*.phtml"]).filter(f=>!/(^|\/)(vendor|node_modules|tests?|spec)\//.test(f));const code=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>!/^\s*(\*|\/\/|#|\/\*)/.test(l)).join("\n");const bad=src.filter(f=>{const t=code(f);return /\$_(POST|REQUEST)\s*\[/.test(t)&&!/nonce|check_admin_referer|check_ajax_referer|permission_callback/i.test(t)});if(bad.length){console.error("request without nonce in: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-wp-prepared-queries** A WordPress database call (`$wpdb->query`, `get_results`, `get_var`, `get_row`, `get_col`) never builds its SQL from an interpolated or concatenated variable; it goes through `$wpdb->prepare`. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const sh=(a)=>cp.execFileSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);const src=sh(["ls-files","-z","--","*.php","*.phtml"]).filter(f=>!/(^|\/)(vendor|node_modules|tests?|spec)\//.test(f));const code=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>!/^\s*(\*|\/\/|#|\/\*)/.test(l)).join("\n");const call=/\$wpdb->(query|get_results|get_var|get_row|get_col)\(\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|\x27([^\x27]*)\x27\s*\.\s*(\S+))/g;const own=/\{?\$wpdb->\w+\}?|\{?\$\w*(table|prefix)\w*\}?/gi;const bad=src.filter(f=>{const t=code(f);let m;while((m=call.exec(t))){const sql=(m[2]??"").replace(own,"");if(/\$\w/.test(sql))return true;if(m[4]!==undefined&&!/^(\$wpdb->|\$\w*(table|prefix))/i.test(m[4]))return true}return false});if(bad.length){console.error("unprepared query in: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-wp-rest-permission-callback** Every WordPress `register_rest_route` call declares a `permission_callback`; a public route says so with `__return_true`. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const sh=(a)=>cp.execFileSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);const src=sh(["ls-files","-z","--","*.php","*.phtml"]).filter(f=>!/(^|\/)(vendor|node_modules|tests?|spec)\//.test(f));const code=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>!/^\s*(\*|\/\/|#|\/\*)/.test(l)).join("\n");const bad=src.filter(f=>{const t=code(f);const n=(t.match(/\bregister_rest_route\s*\(/g)||[]).length;return n>0&&(t.match(/[\x27"]permission_callback[\x27"]/g)||[]).length<n});if(bad.length){console.error("register_rest_route without permission_callback in: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-wp-capability-with-nonce** A WordPress PHP file that verifies a nonce (`wp_verify_nonce`, `check_admin_referer`, `check_ajax_referer`) also checks a capability with `current_user_can`, unless it only serves logged-out `nopriv` hooks. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const sh=(a)=>cp.execFileSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);const src=sh(["ls-files","-z","--","*.php","*.phtml"]).filter(f=>!/(^|\/)(vendor|node_modules|tests?|spec)\//.test(f));const code=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>!/^\s*(\*|\/\/|#|\/\*)/.test(l)).join("\n");const bad=src.filter(f=>{const t=code(f);return /\b(wp_verify_nonce|check_admin_referer|check_ajax_referer)\s*\(/.test(t)&&!/\b(current_user_can|user_can)\s*\(/.test(t)&&!/wp_ajax_nopriv_|admin_post_nopriv_/.test(t)});if(bad.length){console.error("nonce without capability check in: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-wp-sanitize-before-store** WordPress never stores a raw `$_POST`, `$_GET` or `$_REQUEST` value with `update_option`, `add_option` or a `*_meta` writer: the value passes a `sanitize_*`, `absint`, `intval`, `wp_kses*` or a typed cast first. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const sh=(a)=>cp.execFileSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);const src=sh(["ls-files","-z","--","*.php","*.phtml"]).filter(f=>!/(^|\/)(vendor|node_modules|tests?|spec)\//.test(f));const code=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>!/^\s*(\*|\/\/|#|\/\*)/.test(l)).join("\n");const bad=src.filter(f=>{const t=code(f);const call=/\b(update_option|add_option|update_site_option|update_post_meta|add_post_meta|update_user_meta|add_user_meta|update_term_meta|add_term_meta)\s*\(([^;]*)\)\s*;/g;let m;while((m=call.exec(t))){if(/\$_(POST|GET|REQUEST)\s*\[/.test(m[2])&&!/sanitize_\w+|absint|intval|floatval|boolval|wp_kses\w*|esc_url_raw|filter_var|\(\s*(int|bool|float)\s*\)/.test(m[2]))return true}return false});if(bad.length){console.error("raw request value stored in: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-wp-text-domain-literal** WordPress translation calls pass the text domain as one string literal, the same in every call of the repository (the `default` core domain aside). _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const sh=(a)=>cp.execFileSync("git",a,{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);const src=sh(["ls-files","-z","--","*.php","*.phtml"]).filter(f=>!/(^|\/)(vendor|node_modules|tests?|spec)\//.test(f));const code=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n").filter(l=>!/^\s*(\*|\/\/|#|\/\*)/.test(l)).join("\n");const re=/\b(?:__|_e|esc_html__|esc_attr__|esc_html_e|esc_attr_e|_x|esc_html_x|esc_attr_x)\s*\(((?:[^()]|\([^()]*\))*)\)/g;const domains=new Set();let bad="";for(const f of src){const t=code(f);let m;while((m=re.exec(t))){const args=m[1].split(/,(?![^(]*\))/).map(s=>s.trim());const last=args.length>=2?args[args.length-1]:"";const lit=/^[\x27"]([\w-]+)[\x27"]$/.exec(last);if(args.length>=2&&!lit&&/^\$/.test(last))bad=bad||f+" (variable domain)";if(lit&&lit[1]!=="default")domains.add(lit[1])}}if(domains.size>1)bad=bad||"several domains: "+[...domains].join(", ");if(bad){console.error(bad);process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-wp-release-version-matches-readme** A WordPress plugin that ships a readme.txt keeps its `Stable tag` equal to the `Version` header of the plugin file. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `[ ! -f readme.txt ] || node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),cp=require("child_process");const r=fs.readFileSync("readme.txt","utf8").match(/^Stable tag:\s*(\S+)/mi);if(!r||r[1]==="trunk")process.exit(0);const files=cp.execFileSync("git",["ls-files","-z","--","*.php"],{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(f=>f&&!f.includes("/"));const v=files.map(f=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").slice(0,8192)).map(t=>/^[ \t*@]*Plugin Name:/mi.test(t)&&t.match(/^[ \t*@]*Version:\s*(\S+)/mi)).find(Boolean);if(v&&v[1]!==r[1]){console.error("Stable tag "+r[1]+" differs from Version "+v[1]);process.exit(1)}'`)_
- **s-semantic-commits** Commit subjects since the repository adopted krn are semantic: `type(scope): outcome` with a conventional type such as feat, fix, docs, chore or refactor. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! { a=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- krn.json 2>/dev/null | tail -1); git log --no-merges -n 20 --format=%s ${a:+$a..HEAD}; } | grep -vE '^(Revert "|(feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor|test|perf|build|ci|style|revert)(\([^)]+\))?!?: )' | grep -q .`)_
- **s-noninteractive-remote-commands** Tracked shell scripts run ssh and scp with `-o BatchMode=yes` and apt-get install with `-y`, so they fail instead of waiting for a prompt. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -hIE '^[[:space:]]*(sudo[[:space:]]+)?(ssh|scp)[[:space:]]|apt-get[[:space:]]+install' -- '*.sh' | grep -vE 'BatchMode=yes|apt-get[[:space:]]+install[^#]*[[:space:]]-y' | grep -q .`)_
- **s-no-whitespace-errors** Uncommitted changes pass `git diff --check`: no trailing whitespace, no space-before-tab, no conflict markers. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || git diff --check HEAD`)_
- **s-skill-acf-component** Every ACF field group JSON file under `acf-json/` parses and carries its stored `key`. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const f=cp.execFileSync("git",["ls-files","-z"],{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter((p)=>/(^|\/)acf-json\/[^\/]+\.json$/.test(p));let bad=0;for(const p of f){try{const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"));if(typeof j.key!=="string"||j.key==="")bad=1}catch{bad=1}}process.exit(bad)'`)_
- **s-skill-cube-css** Theme CSS carries no `!important` without a comment on the same line. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -nIE '!important' -- '*themes/*.css' ':(exclude)*.min.css' ':(exclude)*node_modules*' ':(exclude)*vendor*' ':(exclude)*/dist/*' ':(exclude)*/build/*' | grep -vF '/*' | grep -q .`)_
- **s-skill-plesk-deploy** Deploy workflows and deploy files neither disable SSH host-key checking nor use the release tooling without a commit SHA pin. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const cp=require("child_process"),fs=require("fs");const f=cp.execFileSync("git",["ls-files","-z","--",".github/workflows","deploy"],{encoding:"utf8"}).split("\0").filter(Boolean);let bad=0;for(const p of f){let t;try{t=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")}catch{continue}if(/StrictHostKeyChecking[ =]+no/.test(t))bad=1;if(/release-tooling/.test(t)&&!/\b[0-9a-f]{40}\b/.test(t))bad=1}process.exit(bad)'`)_
- **s-skill-wp-runtime** `.env`, `auth.json` and `node_modules/` are not tracked. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)(\.env|auth\.json)$|(^|/)node_modules/'`)_
- **s-no-private-key-tracked** No tracked file holds a PEM private key block (a line that starts with `-----BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY-----`), outside test fixtures. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `! git grep -qIE '^-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----' -- . ':(exclude)test' ':(exclude)tests' ':(exclude)*/fixtures/*'`)_
- **s-no-wildcard-dependencies** package.json and composer.json never declare a dependency at `*`, `latest` or a development branch: a version range names a floor and a ceiling. _(checked by `krn standards check`: `node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const bad=[];const scan=(f,keys,re)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(f))return;let j;try{j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"))}catch{return}for(const k of keys)for(const [n,v] of Object.entries(j[k]||{}))if(re.test(String(v).trim()))bad.push(f+":"+n)};scan("package.json",["dependencies","devDependencies","optionalDependencies"],/^(\*|latest|x|)$/i);scan("composer.json",["require","require-dev"],/^(\*|dev-(master|main|trunk))$/i);if(bad.length){console.error("unbounded: "+bad.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'`)_
<!-- krn-standards:end -->
